name: OneShot
summary: Agent service that takes a goal and a budget and keeps working on it over weeks or months with its own set of real-world tools (calls, mail, research); its tools can also be called one by one and paid per call over x402.

Commonworld's own unpaid check: an unpaid POST to https://win.oneshotagent.com/v1/tools/web-read answered HTTP 402 with x402 v2 payment terms (scheme exact; network Base; asset USDC; price 0.002 USDC; payTo Base 0x9fb365E4E9385E2a39FeBAd70368267e6f571d9A). YourAITools lists the price as $0.001–$0.07. No payment was made; a 402 shows the endpoint is up and asks for payment, not that the paid service works. The probed route is not the cheapest one listed.
